stories.headline: iPhone 18 won’t debut this fall, here’s why
stories.summary: Apple is reportedly adopting a split release schedule for the iPhone 18 lineup, consisting of six models: iPhone 18, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone 18e, iPhone Air 2, and iPhone Ultra. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with the iPhone Ultra featuring a folding screen, are expected to debut this fall. In contrast, the standard iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and second-generation iPhone Air are anticipated to launch in late winter or early spring 2027. This scheduling change may be intended to boost average selling prices and revenue during the holiday sales period by releasing the higher-margin iPhone 18 Pro models first. The delayed release of the standard iPhone 18 models could also help Apple to save its less expensive options for early 2027. This shift marks a departure from Apple's traditional launch schedule.

stories.headline: OnePlus N6x's battery capacity confirmed
stories.summary: OnePlus has confirmed the battery capacity of its upcoming smartphone, the OnePlus N6x, as 7,000mAh. The device is set to launch in India on July 31 and promises up to 2.5 days of battery life on a single charge. The battery is made of Silicon-Carbon (Si-C) material. The phone will be available in Burgundy Red, among other colors. With a large battery and 45W fast charging support, the OnePlus N6x aims to target users who prioritize long-lasting battery life. The confirmation comes ahead of the phone's launch, with more details expected to be revealed in the coming days. The device's microsite on Amazon India has also revealed the battery capacity and claimed battery backup details, generating buzz around the upcoming smartphone. The launch is highly anticipated, with the phone expected to be a significant addition to the OnePlus lineup.

stories.headline: Oppo Find W Is Set to Arrive With New Design, But Recently Leaked Images Are All AI-Generated
stories.summary: Oppo is reportedly working on a new device called the Oppo Find W, which is expected to arrive in early 2027. The device is said to feature a 16:10 aspect ratio screen, offering a wider viewing experience with ultra-narrow bezels. This would make it the world's first Android wide-slab flagship, introducing a new form factor that differs from traditional smartphones. Recently leaked images of the device have been circulating, but they are reportedly AI-generated and not actual renders of the phone. The Oppo Find W is expected to provide a larger viewing area for media and multitasking, and its unique design could potentially introduce a new hardware category for Android flagships. The device's specifications and features are still unconfirmed, but it is generating interest among tech enthusiasts due to its innovative design.

stories.headline: Silent Hill f writers were challenged to read "100-200 books a year" during production
stories.summary: Silent Hill f's scriptwriters were challenged to read 100-200 books a year during production to thoroughly understand the style and quirks of writer Ryukishi07. According to producer Motoi Okamoto, the writers "pressured each other" to meet this goal, which included reading books from Ryukishi07. This approach aimed to ensure the writers had a deep understanding of the writer's work and could effectively adapt it into the game. The challenge was part of the production process for Silent Hill f, a game that follows the success of the Silent Hill 2 remake, which was released to critical and commercial acclaim in October 2024. Konami's strategy of partnering with external developers has been validated, and the company continues to work on new Silent Hill titles, including Silent Hill f. The intense reading regimen was a key aspect of the game's development.
